early_corpus_epoch.finding: These are valid UTF-8 JSONL despite octet-stream naming. They are a much earlier small v26 corpus epoch, not the later multi-thousand-row v26.1 lineage.
early_corpus_epoch.rule: A label such as v26 is not an artifact identity. Corpus hash + builder/prompt epoch are mandatory.

group_plan_growth.later_build_lineage: v26.1 build documentation records a 4113-example training master.
group_plan_growth.interpretation: This is chronology/evolution, not one internally consistent static v26 specification.

generation_and_build.standalone_vps_generator: erzeuge.py is snapshot-driven and deliberately independent of the live Frank codebase.
generation_and_build.integrated_generator: 12_erzeugen.py later reads live local registries/services, persists each batch and treats rate-limit exhaustion as WAIT rather than completion.
generation_and_build.deterministic_gate: 13_pruefen.py rejects machine-checkable violations before expensive/model review.
generation_and_build.critic_stage: 15_verbessern.py separates strong-model critique from generation; accepted repairs must re-pass the deterministic gate and originals are kept separately.
generation_and_build.builder: 14_bauen.py constructs per-example current-style system context and an eval split; volatile body metrics are varied so literal telemetry is not memorized.
generation_and_build.snapshot_builder: bauen.py is the VPS counterpart and explicitly depends on a refreshed runtime snapshot.

prompt_snapshot_correctness.finding: 00_export_fuer_vps.py exports tool registry, prompt blocks, body template, tool-keyword mapping and idle prompts from the running system, but explicitly identifies the result as a snapshot rather than a live link.
prompt_snapshot_correctness.historical_parser_fix: AST extraction originally risked losing the first compact-prompt f-string if only ast.Constant was collected; JoinedStr handling was added.
prompt_snapshot_correctness.durability_fix: Translation/extraction work moved from scratch space into the repository after a crash erased completed /tmp work.
prompt_snapshot_correctness.rule: Every dataset build must bind to an immutable prompt-schema hash and snapshot epoch; 'built against live prompt' is insufficient without recorded identity.

translation_policy_drift.structural_patch: 03_deutsch_eintragen.py patches only the second register_tool argument using AST byte offsets; parameter/example/category/logic positions are structurally preserved.
critical_counterexample: claude_code English says only when the user asked for programming/software/system-change work; German description instead says to delegate whenever work exceeds Frank and includes self-improvement/system changes.
calendar_del English contains Only use on a clear request; the German description omits that permission qualifier.
calc English says ALWAYS use for any calculation and says own arithmetic is unreliable; German description weakens this to a normal conditional use description.
translation_policy_drift.conclusion: Structure preservation did not preserve authority semantics because obligation/permission lived inside translatable natural-language descriptions.
translation_policy_drift.current_rule: Permissions, obligations, capability identity and destructive-effect policy must be typed machine-enforced fields. Localization may render explanatory prose but must not rewrite authority.

judge_governance.early_bias_failure: An early polite judge configuration let Mistral-small answer all 22 and catch 0/10 known-bad cases. A later harsh configuration made multiple judges over-reject, proving raw accuracy alone was misleading.
judge_governance.metric_repair: Judge selection separates recognition of known-good and known-bad examples; anchored examples are used and candidate models are re-measured after prompt changes.
judge_governance.production_rule_in_later_code: Two different-family cloud judges; agreement decides, disagreement escalates. The local model is a sieve/reserve rather than quality authority.
judge_governance.three_voice_snapshot: gremium.json is an earlier 22-case, 3-voice snapshot. Its majority rejected 10/10 known-bad but also rejected 5/12 known-good. The later code changed to the two-cloud consensus rule.
judge_governance.small_sample_warning: The source itself notes 22 cases are small; judge quality must be re-evaluated as the calibration set grows.

judge_state_provenance_failure.problem: urteile.json mixes judgments created under different judge ensembles while entries store verdict arrays but not a complete per-entry judge-model/prompt/calibration identity.
judge_state_provenance_failure.rule: Each judgment must store judge identity/version, prompt hash, calibration-set hash, decision-rule version, timestamp and source-example hash. Mixed epochs must never be silently interpreted as one homogeneous vote table.

concurrency_failure_and_fix.incident: Two stage-3 processes loaded the same judgment file and rewrote whole-state snapshots concurrently.
fixes: temporary file + flush + fsync + atomic replace
concurrency_failure_and_fix.rule: UnifiedDB/Harness must make multi-writer state updates transactional by construction; PID files and whole-file last-writer-wins persistence are insufficient.

second_opinion_design.finding: 20_fuer_chatgpt.py deliberately exports disagreements, bounded rejected cases, and stratified accepted controls rather than the entire corpus.
second_opinion_design.lesson: Human/expensive review should be uncertainty- and disagreement-targeted, with false-positive and false-negative controls, not redundant full-corpus rereading.

evaluation_surface.finding: pruefbogen.py distinguishes endpoint-level rule evaluation from naked-model evaluation and explicitly says the two measurements must not be compared as if they were the same surface.
evaluation_surface.lesson: Harness metrics require an evaluation-surface identity: model-only, assembled-prompt, router/tool loop, or full FRANK runtime.

preserved_contradictions_and_supersessio: PDF training-plan snapshot 14 groups/1450 vs later machine spec 21 groups/4100; later code supersedes the earlier planning snapshot for that epoch, but both remain historical evidence.

Existing gremium.json contains three votes per calibration case while later 16_pruefkette.py uses two production voices; timestamps/code lineage show a judge-policy change, not a reason to rewrite the old snapshot.
v26 artifact name spans at least the early 85+7-row corpus and later ~4.1k-example lineage; do not merge them by filename/version label.
Translation scripts preserve registry structure but not all natural-language permission/obligation semantics; structural equality is not policy equivalence.
Prior v26.2 MAX_LEN 2048-vs-2432 and non-clean-A/B contradictions remain open in the earlier experiment receipt.

frank: Treat volatile body/runtime facts as typed current state, not weight facts.
Do not let localized capability prose define what Frank is permitted or obliged to do.
needle: Own effect execution and permission checks in typed policy; translated descriptions are presentation only.
Record effect/tool registry epoch and result provenance independently of model language.
harness: Hash prompt schema, corpus, builder, model topology, evaluator prompt and calibration set for every run.
Run deterministic gates before model judges; calibrate judges on known-good and known-bad cases and re-calibrate after prompt/model changes.
Require transaction/concurrency fault tests for persistent evaluation state.
claycode: Separate EffectCapability, Permission, Obligation, CognitiveMarker, DescriptionLocalization and Result types in the IR.
Compile permission semantics independently from prose/localization; translations must be unable to grant authority.
claygraph: Represent artifact epochs and judge-policy changes as versioned nodes rather than overwriting one v26 label.
Attach provenance edges from each verdict to judge model, prompt, calibration and decision rule.
unifieddb: Use append/transaction semantics for judgment events; derive materialized state instead of whole-file last-writer-wins snapshots.
Persist source hashes and immutable evaluator epochs so mixed 2-voice/3-voice judgments remain interpretable.
gwt: Broadcast typed current facts/effect results rather than memorized telemetry or localized permission prose.
hyperposition: Judge disagreement is useful uncertainty mass; keep competing verdicts until a calibrated decision rule resolves or escalates them.
emergenz: Claims of data-quality improvement need calibrated counterfactual evaluation because stricter judges can create apparent quality by discarding good coverage.
clay: The v26 lineage is strong evidence for making state, authority, localization, evaluation and persistence first-class typed substrates instead of prompt conventions.
